mapper.select: SELECT id,order_id,notification_type,title,message,status,read_at,created_at FROM customer_notifications WHERE customer_id=#{customerId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_notifications WHERE customer_id=#{customerId} AND status='UNREAD'
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_notifications SET status='READ',read_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND customer_id=#{customerId} AND status='UNREAD'
UPDATE customer_notifications SET status='READ',read_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE customer_id=#{customerId} AND status='UNREAD'
mapper.select: SELECT id,event_id,topic,payload,status,attempts FROM notification_delivery_outbox WHERE status IN ('NEW','RETRY') AND next_attempt_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_delivery_outbox SET status='PUBLISHED',attempts=attempts+1,published_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,last_error=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('NEW','RETRY')
UPDATE notification_delivery_outbox SET status='RETRY',next_attempt_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,last_error=NULL WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND status='DEAD'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM notification_projection_windows WHERE status IN ('RUNNING','READY') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_projection_windows(start_notification_id) SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id),0) FROM customer_notifications HAVING NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM notification_projection_windows WHERE status IN ('RUNNING','READY') )
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_projection_windows SET status='READY',ready_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING'
UPDATE notification_projection_windows SET status='RUNNING',ready_at=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='READY'
UPDATE notification_projection_windows SET status='STOPPED',stopped_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='READY'
mapper.select: SELECT start_notification_id FROM notification_projection_windows WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT status FROM notification_projection_windows WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_notifications n JOIN notification_projection_shadow s ON s.window_id=#{windowId} AND s.event_id=n.event_id WHERE n.id>#{startNotificationId} AND n.customer_id=s.customer_id AND COALESCE(n.order_id,-1)=COALESCE(s.order_id,-1) AND n.notification_type=s.notification_type AND n.title=s.title AND n.message=s.message
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_notifications n LEFT JOIN notification_projection_shadow s ON s.window_id=#{windowId} AND s.event_id=n.event_id WHERE n.id>#{startNotificationId} AND s.event_id IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification_projection_shadow s LEFT JOIN customer_notifications n ON n.event_id=s.event_id WHERE s.window_id=#{windowId} AND n.event_id IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_notifications n JOIN notification_projection_shadow s ON s.window_id=#{windowId} AND s.event_id=n.event_id WHERE n.id>#{startNotificationId} AND ( n.customer_id<>s.customer_id OR COALESCE(n.order_id,-1)<>COALESCE(s.order_id,-1) OR n.notification_type<>s.notification_type OR n.title<>s.title OR n.message<>s.message )
